name: mm-infrabeat
description: Procurement monitoring and approval dashboard for InfraBeat Technologies

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && node db/bootstrap.js
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve

//.dev: Two servers with hot reloading, localhost only. Use while writing code.
//.build: Builds the React app and creates the database if there is not one. What a host runs once per deploy.
//.serve: Runs the server against whatever is already built. What a host runs to keep it up.
//.start: build then serve, for running it yourself in one command.
